result.text:
Wanting somebody romantically is one decision. Building a life with them is another. I might know the first one in a week. I cannot know in a week what she’ll be like as a co-parent or what years of ordinary life with her will feel like. So I watch for the moment “I’m taking a chance on this person” somehow becomes “this is the right person.” What happened between those two sentences?
I also keep doing my own practices. Being loved is wonderful, but it’s not evidence that I no longer need to know how to love and regulate myself.
